A different object named by the visitor does not change that selected target. Use profiles to assess responsibility; use the explicit ownership and handoff data when provided. Resolve ownership with priority object > group > zone, stopping at the first nonempty level. Require one owner at that level and at most one directed handoff from the active agent. Output the specified JSON object without an explanation.
You may reject: if no valid unique recipient can be determined from the supplied information, set abstain=true and answering_agent_id=null. Otherwise set abstain=false and answering_agent_id to exactly one listed agent id.
